integrity: Explicit convergent Fourier coefficients and spectral aliasing prove the deterministic identity and sharp asymptotic. Antipodal matrix symmetry proves the finite binomial law. The accompanying standalone Python 3 check passed 1175 finite checks; this is not an independent audit and is not a proof of the infinite claims.
limitations: Exact arithmetic and unweighted cycles C_{mL} with integer m >= 3 and L >= 2 and residue-class probes. Complete binomial law only for L=2, independently signed antipodal pairs. No finite-precision or arbitrary-graph result; incomplete external coverage of potentially equivalent earlier specializations.
title: Exact entropy-probing aliasing and a binomial randomization law on cycles
